system.description:
Wit; 1 Soul; Medium (50 ft). Explosive (C): every enemy within 5 ft (Close) of the target hit also takes the damage. Sensory Overload: every enemy within 50 ft (Medium) of the Strike must pass a CR 2 Smarts Check or be Blinded until your next Combat Round.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.147

automation.note: Sensory Overload: every other enemy within Medium Range (50 ft) of the Strike also makes a CR 2 Smarts Check or is Blinded. Target them, post the Flashbang to chat and click its Blinded button.

when.label: Sensory Overload: other enemies within 50 ft of the Strike

automation.note: Explosive (C): this damage, and its effects, also hit every enemy within Close Range (5 ft) of the target.
